$comment: Characterized from the legacy game on 2026-11-25 (game.py:50-301, 410-412). The order of each list is the order the API shows.

locations.title: BRICK LANE
locations.description: YOU ARE STANDING AT THE END OF BRICK LANE BEFORE A SMALL BRICK BUILDING CALLED THE OLD TRUMAN BREWERY. AROUND YOU IS A FOREST OF RESTAURANTS. A SMALL STREAM OF CRAFTED BEER FLOWS OUT OF THE BUILDING AND DOWN A GULLY.

locations.title: OLD TRUMAN BREWERY
locations.description: YOU ARE INSIDE THE OLD BREWERY. COPPER VATS LINE THE WALLS. A STAIRCASE GOES UP TO THE ROOF AND A TRAPDOOR GOES DOWN TO THE CELLAR.

locations.title: BREWERY CELLAR
locations.description: A COLD CELLAR FULL OF EMPTY BARRELS. SOMETHING SHINES ON THE FLOOR. IN A CORNER, A METAL SLIDE GOES DOWN INTO THE DARK.

locations.title: BREWERY ROOFTOP
locations.description: YOU ARE ON THE ROOF OF THE BREWERY. YOU CAN SEE ALL OF SHOREDITCH.

locations.title: SPITALFIELDS MARKET
locations.description: THE OLD SPITALFIELDS MARKET. THE STALLS ARE CLOSED FOR THE NIGHT.

locations.title: BACK YARD
locations.description: A SMALL YARD BEHIND THE MARKET. THERE IS A MANHOLE COVER IN THE GROUND.

locations.title: BRICK LANE BAKERY
locations.description: A SMALL BAKERY THAT NEVER CLOSES. THE SHELVES ARE FULL OF BREAD.

locations.title: COLUMBIA ROAD
locations.description: THE COLUMBIA ROAD FLOWER MARKET. SOMEBODY LEFT SOME FLOWERS AND A FEW COINS.

locations.title: BOXPARK
locations.description: SHIPPING CONTAINERS FULL OF SHOPS. MOST OF THEM ARE EMPTY.

locations.title: RAILWAY ARCHES
locations.description: OLD RAILWAY ARCHES. A RUSTY LADDER GOES DOWN INTO A TUNNEL.

locations.title: OLD TUBE TUNNEL
locations.description: AN OLD TUBE TUNNEL. NO TRAIN HAS COME HERE FOR FIFTY YEARS. A LADDER GOES UP.

locations.title: TUNNEL JUNCTION
locations.description: A TUNNEL JUNCTION. OLD SIGNS POINT IN ALL DIRECTIONS.

locations.title: KATACOMBS
locations.description: DAMP STONE TUNNELS. SKULLS LINE THE WALLS. A FAINT LIGHT GLOWS TO THE EAST.

locations.title: KATACOMBS EXIT
locations.description: DAYLIGHT! YOU HAVE FOUND THE WAY OUT OF THE KATACOMBS.
